decisions.reason: Although Product A is less central to the firm's core waste-to-energy direction, the firm has already invested in its launch and is likely to persist, but not as strongly as for core products, yielding a moderate drop probability.

Product B is a modular extension of the firm's established waste-to-energy offer and central to its announced direction, so escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping it despite limited visible promotion.

Product C has the strongest public commitment through its dedicated page and launch announcement and is central to the firm's waste-to-energy solutions, making escalation pressures to keep it very strong and drop probability very low.

Product D is close to the firm's established offer and central to its waste-to-fuel ambitions, so escalation of commitment favors keeping it, though its lower public visibility than Product C gives a slightly higher drop probability.
